_comment: Static, non-secret configuration baked into every workflow's 'Config' node by scripts/build-workflows.js. Copy to config/settings.local.json (git-ignored) to override. Secrets never go here: API keys and OAuth tokens live in n8n credentials.

source._comment: Where your raw leads live. Leave spreadsheet_id empty to use the outreach spreadsheet above. The source sheet is only ever READ.

sender.name: REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_NAME
sender.company_description: FlowHQ builds custom websites and AI automation systems for small and medium-sized businesses.

live_approval._comment: Live sending stays blocked until BOTH fields are filled in by the account owner after reviewing test results.

llm._comment: provider: anthropic | ollama | openai_compatible | template. 'template' uses no AI model at all (zero cost, more formulaic wording). credential_type: anthropicApi | openAiApi | httpHeaderAuth | none (local Ollama). The API key is stored in the n8n credential, never here. For Ollama + Qwen3 4B use the preset in config/presets/ollama-qwen3-4b.json (docs/OLLAMA.md).
